meta.machine: MacBook Pro (15-inch, 2018), 6-core Intel i7-8850H, 16 GB RAM, macOS 15.7
meta.definition: cold end-to-end seconds = user-model construction + problem-data extraction, one shot. engine: cp.Problem build + get_problem_data (median of 3, fresh). casadi: casadi_build_s + casadi_single_s (suite). jump: idiomatic macro build (4-problem worker) or generic block build (FactorCov, ConeStuffing) + copy_to. asl: Pyomo environ build + nl write/read/evals. sct: closure build + detection/coloring/eval. CVaRSlice casadi = probe number (no build split) omitted.
meta.note: JuMP/ASL/SCT builds are post-JIT / warm-process; JuMP's macro layer is where its coefficient assembly happens, so end-to-end is its honest one-shot cost while copy_to alone is its floor.
